The agent incorrectly assumed that an appointment type with ID 5 existed and attempted to set it as default and enable it for providers, resulting in 404 errors. Since the required appointment type does not exist in the database and the tools provided do not allow creating new appointment types, the task cannot be completed. The agent failed to recognize this data inconsistency and did not recover appropriately.
